<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.51.0 -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* [AdvancedLayouts] Add width to `st.plotly_chart` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12559
* Feat: Automatically hide row indices in `st.dataframe` when row selection is active by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12448
* [AdvancedLayouts] Add width to `st.vega_lite_chart` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12517
* Add `codeTextColor` config & update `linkColor`  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12562
* [AdvancedLayouts] Add height to st.vega_lite_chart by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12577
* [AdvancedLayouts] Add width to st.pydeck_chart by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12576
* Use `key` as main identity for `st.color_picker` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12569
* Add `type` argument to `st.popover` to match `st.button` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12598
* [AdvancedLayouts] Add width to st.altair_chart by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12608
* Add `cursor` kwarg to st.write_stream by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12597
* In `streamlit hello`, preload Python modules that are slow to compile in a fresh venv by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12617
* Reusable Custom Themes via `theme.base` config by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12572
* Make `streamlit run` with no args mean `streamlit run streamlit_app.py` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12599
* Allow st.feedback to have a default initial value (#9469) -> #9658 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12578
* [AdvancedLayouts] Add height to st.altair_chart by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12630
* [AdvancedLayouts] Modernize height parameter for st.pydeck_chart by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12613
* [AdvancedLayouts] Update width and height on st.map by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12658
* [AdvancedLayouts] Modernize width/height parameters for st.scatter_chart by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12659
* [AdvancedLayouts] Modernize width and height for st.area_chart and st.bar_chart by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12672
* Custom Dark Theme - add light/dark section configurations for `theme` & `theme.sidebar` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12680
* Use `key` as main identity for `st.segmented_control` widget by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12711
* Use key as main identity for `st.radio` widget by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12705
* Use `key` as main identity for `st.audio_input` widget by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12720
* Add `pinned` parameter to `MultiselectColumn` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12714
* Use `key` as main identity for `st.slider` and `st.select_slider` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12575
* Custom Dark Theme - support light/dark config inheritance & populate new session msg by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12707
* Use `key` as main identity for  `st.chat_input` widget by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12725
* Add support for `auto` color to `MutliselectColumn` using chart colors by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12724
* Allow configuring `color` for `ProgressColumn` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12738
* Use `key` as main identity for `st.feedback` and `st.pills` widgets by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12717
* [AdvancedLayouts] Add stretch height to st.dataframe by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12632
* Custom Dark Theme - theme & sidebar theme creation by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12760
* Custom Dark Theme - main & settings menu updates by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12761
* [feat] Add API for `st.space` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12737
* [feat] Add st.components.v2.components namespace and classes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12686
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Make slider thumbs not overshoot the track by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12549
* Fix vega chart unrecognized dataset error by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11911
* [fix] Add AbortController for async upload operations by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12539
* Fix PlotlyChart flickering by adding overflow hidden by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12594
* Pills do not show selected value(s) if disabled #12388 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12555
* Make our Python Altair code thread-safe by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12673
* Fix file watcher issue with common path check by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12741
* [fix] showErrorDetails config parsing for deprecation warnings by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12794
* Make sure error message is explicitly shown for 500 errors by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12845
* Makes fuzzy search case insensitive by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12849
* [fix] DataFrame content width horizontal alignment by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12682
* [fix] pyplot/image width regression in fragments, containers by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12807
### Other Changes
* Update vega_lite_chart width parameter default handling for type consistency by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12595
* [chore] Release v1.50.0 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12612
* Settings menu updates by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12648
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12669
* Clarify dataframe data types when starting with empty columns by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12779
* Selection widgets return copies by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12778
* Fix grammar/typos in config documentation by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12783
* Remove Python 3.9 support by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12773
* Custom Dark Theme - section updates & e2e tests by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12798

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12578
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12555
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12652

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.50.0...1.51.0
